resources.string: Save photos and videos from statuses you’ve viewed.
Android needs your permission once. We’ll open the WhatsApp Media folder directly—just tap \'Use this folder\' then \'Allow\' to view your statuses automatically.
View a photo or video status in WhatsApp, then return here. The list updates automatically.
No compatible photos or videos found.
Supported: JPEG, PNG, WebP and compatible MP4 video. Encrypted and incomplete files cannot be saved.
Saved to Gallery in MediaFlow’s status folder. The selected download folder cannot publish this media type.
This provider allows access for this session only. Choose the folder or files again if access expires.
Showing up to 300 local files. Select individual files to access other items.
Some unavailable or unsupported files were skipped.
Allow access to display the statuses on your device.
Status access has expired. Allow access again to continue.
Choose .Statuses, or its Media parent. MediaFlow does not scan unrelated folders.
This folder belongs to the other WhatsApp source. Choose the matching source or folder.
The selected folder does not expose a readable status directory. Try another accessible status folder or select individual files.
This file is no longer accessible. It may have been removed or its access may have expired.
The file changed while being read. Refresh the list and try again.
This file type is not supported.
This file cannot be read or verified as complete media.
This file is too large for Status Saver.
There isn’t enough storage space to save this status.
The copy could not be published. Your original status file has not been changed.
On this Android version, select a destination file to export the original copy. Gallery visibility depends on the selected provider.
